slides.text: Someone [[hungrier]] is outworking you right now.
They are not more talented. They just [[show up]] more.
Every skipped day is a [[vote]] to stay the same.
Envy is [[information]]. Take the lesson, skip the shame.
Close the app. Do the [[hard]] thing for one hour.
Small [[reps]], done daily, close any gap.
Decide now. [[Save]] this, then send it to the one who needs the push.
